<translated_code>
import sys

class Test:
    def __init__(self):
        self.writer = sys.stdout
        self.R = 0
        self.C = 0
        self.ch = [[0] * 61 for _ in range(61)]
        self.cntA = [0] * 61
        self.cntB = [0] * 61
        self.best = float('inf')
        self.str = ''
        self.cache = {}

    @staticmethod
    def readInt():
        ans = 0
        neg = False
        start = False
        while True:
            c = sys.stdin.read(1)
            if not c:
                break
            if c == '-':
                neg = True
                start = True
                break
            elif c.isdigit():
                start = True
                ans = ans * 10 + int(c)
            elif start:
                break
        return -ans if neg else ans

    @staticmethod
    def readLong():
        ans = 0
        neg = False
        start = False
        while True:
            c = sys.stdin.read(1)
            if not c:
                break
            if c == '-':
                neg = True
                start = True
                break
            elif c.isdigit():
                start = True
                ans = ans * 10 + int(c)
            elif start:
                break
        return -ans if neg else ans

    @staticmethod
    def readString():
        b = []
        start = False
        while True:
            c = sys.stdin.read(1)
            if not c:
                break
            if c.isalnum() or c == '?':
                start = True
                b.append(c)
            elif start:
                break
        return ''.join(b)

    @staticmethod
    def readChars(a, off):
        cnt = 0
        start = False
        while True:
            c = sys.stdin.read(1)
            if not c:
                break
            if c.isalnum():
                start = True
                a[off + cnt] = c
                cnt += 1
            elif start:
                break
        return cnt

    def dfs(self, x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if self.best <= 1 or diff - self.ch[v1][self.R] * self.ch[v2][self.R] >= self.best:
            return
        if v1 == self.R - 1 and v2 == self.R - 1:
            if diff < self.best:
                self.best = diff
            return
        if v1 >= self.R:
            cur = self.ch[v1][self.R] - self.ch[v1 - 1][self.R]
            other = self.ch[v2][self.R]
            self.dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if v2 >= self.R:
            cur = self.ch[v2][self.R] - self.ch[v2 - 1][self.R]
            other = self.ch[v1][self.R]
            self.dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)

    def solve(self, x, y, v1, v2):
        diff = abs(x - y)
        if diff - self.ch[v1][self.R] * self.ch[v2][self.R] > self.best:
            return 0
        key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2
        if key in self.cache:
            return self.cache[key]
        if v1 < self.R or v2 < self.R:
            sum_val = v1 + v2
            if v1 >= self.cntA[sum_val] and v2 >= self.cntB[sum_val]:
                new_v1 = v1 - self.cntA[sum_val]
                new_v2 = v2 - self.cntB[sum_val]
                res = self.ch[new_v1 + new_v2][new_v1] if new_v1 >=0 and new_v1<=60 and new_v2>=0 and new_v2<=60 else 0
                self.cache[key] = res
                return res
            return 0
        ans = 0
        c = self.str[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if c != 'B':
            cur = self.ch[v1][self.R] - self.ch[v1 - 1][self.R]
            other = self.ch[v2][self.R]
            ans += self.solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2)
        if c != 'A':
            cur = self.ch[v2][self.R] - self.ch[v2 - 1][self.R]
            other = self.ch[v1][self.R]
            ans += self.solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        self.cache[key] = ans
        return ans

    def start(self):
        self.R = self.readInt()
        self.C = self.readInt()
        n = 2 * (self.R + self.C)
        for i in range(2 * (self.R + self.C) + 1):
            for j in range(i + 1):
                if j == 0 or j == i:
                    self.ch[i][j] = 1
                else:
                    self.ch[i][j] = self.ch[i - 1][j - 1] + self.ch[i - 1][j]
        x = 0
        y = 0
        v1 = self.R + self.C
        v2 = self.R + self.C
        while v1 >= self.R and v2 >= self.R:
            if x > y:
                cur = self.ch[v1][self.R] - self.ch[v1 - 1][self.R]
                other = self.ch[v2][self.R]
                y += cur * other
                v1 -= 1
            else:
                cur = self.ch[v2][self.R] - self.ch[v2 - 1][self.R]
                other = self.ch[v1][self.R]
                x += cur * other
                v2 -= 1
        self.best = abs(x - y)
        self.dfs(0, 0, self.R + self.C, self.R + self.C)
        self.str = self.readString()
        for i in range(n):
            self.cntA[i + 1] = self.cntA[i] + (1 if self.str[i] == 'A' else 0)
            self.cntB[i + 1] = self.cntB[i] + (1 if self.str[i] == 'B' else 0)
        ans = self.solve(0, 0, self.R + self.C, self.R + self.C)
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test = Test()
    test.start()
